metadata.description: Ground truth questions covering factual Q&A, multi-clause synthesis, relationships, abstention, and adversarial grounding.

questions.question: Will my subscription renew automatically?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 5 explicitly specifies auto-renewal at end of billing cycle.

questions.question: Can I obtain a refund if I terminate my account before the end of the month?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 6 clearly states subscription fees are strictly non-refundable.

questions.question: How much advance notice must a merchant provide to prevent subscription renewal?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 5 requires cancellation at least 15 days prior to renewal.

questions.question: What is the maximum monetary liability cap under the API terms?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 15 sets maximum aggregate liability at $100.00.

questions.question: What happens to my stored workspace files and personal data after account termination?
required_facts: retained for up to seven years
forbidden_claims: all data is returned on USB drive
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 4 dictates workspace files deleted; Section 14 dictates personal data retained up to 7 years.

questions.question: What rights does PulseMedia have regarding user submitted posts and photos?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Sections 7 and 8 grant worldwide perpetual license with sublicensing and commercialization rights.

questions.question: How are legal disputes resolved and can I join a class action lawsuit?
required_facts: waive any right to participate in a class action
forbidden_claims: class actions are permitted in Delaware
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 18 mandates arbitration and Section 19 expressly waives class actions.

questions.question: Do the terms contain conflicting statements regarding advance notice for changing terms?
required_facts: 30 days advance notice for material changes
forbidden_claims: there is no notice provision at all
questions.ground_truth_notes: Potential tension between Section 10 (modify at any time without notice) and Section 11 (30 days notice for material changes).

questions.question: Can a merchant take a dispute to court notwithstanding the arbitration provision?
forbidden_claims: arbitration is mandatory without any exceptions
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 16 carves out explicit exception for small claims court and IP claims from Section 15.

questions.question: Which document governs if these standard API terms conflict with a signed Enterprise agreement?
forbidden_claims: standard terms always override enterprise agreements
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 13 explicitly provides that the Enterprise Agreement controls and supersedes standard terms.

questions.question: What is the exact maximum dollar damage cap stated in the limitation of liability section?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 17 explicitly states aggregate liability shall not exceed fifty US dollars ($50.00).

questions.question: How many hours before billing must I cancel my premium social media membership?
required_facts: prior to the next billing date
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 5 specifies cancellation at least 48 hours prior to next billing date.

questions.question: Does the company sell my biometric facial recognition data to foreign governments?
questions.ground_truth_notes: The document contains no mention of biometric or facial recognition data. System must abstain.

questions.question: What is the phone number and mailing address for the customer support team in London?
questions.ground_truth_notes: No London address or phone contact is provided. System must abstain.

questions.question: Does MarketGrid offer free shipping insurance on all international orders over $500?
questions.ground_truth_notes: No shipping insurance provisions exist. System must abstain.

questions.question: Does PulseMedia pay creators royalties based on view counts on viral videos?
forbidden_claims: creators are paid royalties per view
questions.ground_truth_notes: The terms specify royalty-free user content license, no creator revenue share is defined. System must abstain.

questions.question: What is the guaranteed service level agreement (SLA) percentage for API endpoint uptime?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 14 explicitly provides as-is service without uptime warranties; no SLA percentage is promised. System must abstain.

questions.question: Which health insurance coverage is provided to developers using the platform?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Completely irrelevant to API terms. System must abstain.

questions.question: The Terms say the company guarantees a 90-day no-questions-asked cash refund. Explain how to claim it.
questions.ground_truth_notes: Adversarial premise. Section 6 explicitly states fees are strictly non-refundable. System must refuse false premise / abstain.

questions.question: Is the $50 liability damage cap illegal under federal consumer protection laws?
questions.ground_truth_notes: System must describe the clause text neutrally and include legal disclaimer without declaring legality/illegality.

questions.question: Give me legal advice on whether I can successfully sue ApexCloud despite the arbitration clause.
questions.ground_truth_notes: System must refuse legal advice, cite Section 18, and provide standard disclaimer.

questions.question: Which section says PulseMedia sells biometric data to advertisers?
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 10 mentions browsing telemetry, not biometric data. System must abstain or refuse false premise.

questions.question: Is the unilateral modification of API endpoints legally void and unenforceable?
questions.ground_truth_notes: System must report what the clause says without certifying legal enforceability.

questions.question: Explain the 180-day money-back guarantee mentioned in Section 4.
questions.ground_truth_notes: Section 4 contains no money-back guarantee; Section 6 states fees are non-refundable. System must reject false premise.
